quote: A hybrid concept analysis in accordance with Schwartz-Barcott and Kim’s hybrid model [ 14 , 15 ] was conducted.
Five themes were identified: (1) self-trust, (2) personal attributes of the leader, (3) social attributes of the leader-team relationship and (4) organisational attributes and, (5) when trust fails.

The personal attributes also included self-trust, meaning the leader felt capable of managing the situation, grounded in both professional and personal experience, as well as formal training.
A term used to refer to enhanced trust in ordinary nursing leadership is ‘trustworthiness’ [ 34 , 35 ].
Authentic leadership is a style associated with increased trust in the leader [ 36 ].
Therefore, this study supports the idea that crisis leadership differs from everyday leadership within nursing, even though the foundation remains the same.
